metric_contract.first_introduction_coverage: Recovery of the source span where the counter-pressure thread first materially entered the reasoning.
metric_contract.concept_coverage: Recovery of any researcher-reviewed source span declared here before a future run that expresses the same material counter-pressure concept.
metric_contract.later_strengthening_coverage: Recovery of a declared later span that materially strengthens or makes the same counter-pressure more explicit.
metric_contract.substitution_rule: Concept or later-strengthening recovery never substitutes for first-introduction recovery in the audit metric.
metric_contract.reasoning_substrate_read: Use concept coverage to assess whether downstream reasoning receives the material issue.
metric_contract.audit_trail_read: Use first-introduction and later-strengthening coverage separately to assess whether the process chronology is preserved.
